{-# CHECKPOINTS ["google/gemma-3-270m", "google/gemma-3-270m-it", "google/gemma-3-1b-pt", "google/gemma-3-1b-it", "google/gemma-3-4b-pt", "google/gemma-3-4b-it", "google/gemma-3-12b-pt", "google/gemma-3-12b-it", "google/gemma-3-27b-pt", "google/gemma-3-27b-it"] #-}

import Activations (gelu_pytorch_tanh)
import Attention (attention_gqa_with_additive_mask, mask_to_additive_for_input, merge_heads, reshape_heads)
import Masking (Mask, causal_mask_for_input, mask_for_input, mask_length_for_input)
import Math (mul, sqrt)
import Params (has_root)
import Positions (position_ids, position_ids_scale, rope_base_factors, rope_pair_base_factors)
import Cache
import Config
import NN
import Tensor
MODEL_DIM <- Config.int @@text_config.hidden_size default=(Config.int @@hidden_size default=640)
MODEL_DIM_FLOAT <- Config.float @@text_config.hidden_size default=(Config.float @@hidden_size default=640.0)
EMB_SCALE <- sqrt MODEL_DIM_FLOAT
VOCAB_SIZE <- Config.int @@text_config.vocab_size default=(Config.int @@vocab_size default=262208)
NUM_LAYERS <- Config.int @@text_config.num_hidden_layers default=(Config.int @@num_hidden_layers default=18)
NUM_HEADS <- Config.int @@text_config.num_attention_heads default=(Config.int @@num_attention_heads default=8)
KVH <- Config.int @@text_config.num_key_value_heads default=(Config.int @@num_key_value_heads default=4)
MODEL_HEAD_DIM <- Config.int @@text_config.head_dim default=(Config.int @@head_dim default=256)
FFN <- Config.int @@text_config.intermediate_size default=(Config.int @@intermediate_size default=2048)
ROPE_PERIOD <- Config.int @@text_config._sliding_window_pattern default=(Config.int @@text_config.sliding_window_pattern default=(Config.int @@_sliding_window_pattern default=(Config.int @@sliding_window_pattern default=6)))
THETA_BASE <- Config.float @@text_config.rope_local_base_freq default=(Config.float @@rope_local_base_freq default=10000.0)
THETA_LONG <- Config.float @@text_config.rope_theta default=(Config.float @@rope_theta default=1000000.0)
ROPE_LONG_SCALE <- Config.float @@text_config.rope_scaling.factor default=(Config.float @@rope_scaling.factor default=1.0)
WIN_LOCAL <- Config.int @@text_config.sliding_window default=(Config.int @@sliding_window default=512)
WIN_LONG <- Config.int @@text_config.max_position_embeddings default=(Config.int @@max_position_embeddings default=131072)
QUERY_PRE_ATTN_SCALAR <- Config.float @@text_config.query_pre_attn_scalar default=(Config.float @@query_pre_attn_scalar default=256.0)
ATTN_SCALE = 1.0 / sqrt QUERY_PRE_ATTN_SCALAR
HAS_MODEL_LM_MODEL = has_root "model.language_model.model"
HAS_LM_MODEL = has_root "language_model.model"

gemma3_block :: Tensor[B,S,D] -> Int -> Tensor[B,1,S,R] -> Tensor[B,1,S,R] -> Tensor[B,1,S,R] -> Tensor[B,1,S,R] -> Tensor[B,1,S,K] -> Tensor[B,1,S,K] -> Tensor[B,NUM_HEADS,S,K] -> Tensor[B,NUM_HEADS,S,K] -> ?CacheLayer[B,KVH,P,WIN_LONG,DH] -> (Tensor[B,S,D], ?CacheLayer[B,KVH,K,WIN_LONG,DH])
gemma3_block x i rope_sin_local rope_cos_local rope_sin_long rope_cos_long mask_local mask_long additive_mask_local additive_mask_long past_kv = do
  xn <- NN.rmsnorm@input_layernorm x cast_float=true unit_offset=true
  a, new_kv <- scope@self_attn do
    q <- NN.linear@q_proj xn dim=(NUM_HEADS * MODEL_HEAD_DIM) |> reshape_heads heads=NUM_HEADS |> NN.rmsnorm@q_norm cast_float=true unit_offset=true
    k <- NN.linear@k_proj xn dim=(KVH * MODEL_HEAD_DIM) |> reshape_heads heads=KVH |> NN.rmsnorm@k_norm cast_float=true unit_offset=true
    v <- NN.linear@v_proj xn dim=(KVH * MODEL_HEAD_DIM) |> reshape_heads heads=KVH
    long <- ((i + 1) % ROPE_PERIOD) == 0
    rope_sin <- long ? rope_sin_long : rope_sin_local
    rope_cos <- long ? rope_cos_long : rope_cos_local
    q, k <- rope_pair_base_factors q k rope_sin rope_cos
    k, v, new_kv <- Cache.update past_kv k v
    mask <- long ? mask_long : mask_local
    additive_mask <- long ? additive_mask_long : additive_mask_local
    a <- attention_gqa_with_additive_mask q k v additive_mask mask scale=ATTN_SCALE |> merge_heads |> NN.linear@o_proj dim=MODEL_DIM
    return a, new_kv
  a <- NN.rmsnorm@post_attention_layernorm a cast_float=true unit_offset=true
  x <- x + a
  xn <- NN.rmsnorm@pre_feedforward_layernorm x cast_float=true unit_offset=true
  m <- scope@mlp do
    g <- NN.linear@gate_proj xn dim=FFN
    u <- NN.linear@up_proj xn dim=FFN
    return gelu_pytorch_tanh g |> mul u |> NN.linear@down_proj dim=MODEL_DIM
  m <- NN.rmsnorm@post_feedforward_layernorm m cast_float=true unit_offset=true
  return x + m, new_kv

gemma3_body :: Path -> Tensor.TokenIds[B,S] -> ?Mask[B,K,WIN_LONG] -> ?Cache[B,KVH,P,WIN_LONG,DH] -> ?Bool -> (Tensor[B,S,V], ?Cache[B,KVH,K,WIN_LONG,DH])
gemma3_body@__scope input_ids attn_mask past_kv use_cache = do
  past_length <- Cache.past_length past_kv
  attn_mask <- mask_for_input input_ids attn_mask WIN_LONG
  pos_ids <- position_ids input_ids attn_mask=attn_mask past_length=past_length
  pos_ids_long <- position_ids_scale pos_ids ROPE_LONG_SCALE
  rope_sin_local, rope_cos_local <- rope_base_factors pos_ids MODEL_HEAD_DIM THETA_BASE
  rope_sin_long, rope_cos_long <- rope_base_factors pos_ids_long MODEL_HEAD_DIM THETA_LONG

gemma3_block :: Tensor[B,S,D] -> Int -> Tensor[B,1,S,R] -> Tensor[B,1,S,R] -> Tensor[B,1,S,R] -> Tensor[B,1,S,R] -> Tensor[B,1,S,K] -> Tensor[B,1,S,K] -> Tensor[B,NUM_HEADS,S,K] -> Tensor[B,NUM_HEADS,S,K] -> ?CacheLayer[B,KVH,P,WIN_LONG,DH] -> (Tensor[B,S,D], ?CacheLayer[B,KVH,K,WIN_LONG,DH])

import Math (clamp, floor)
import Tensor (
  and,
  arange,
  cast,
  dtype_value,
  eq,
  expand,
  full,
  gather,
  le,
  reshape,
  size,
  slice,
  where,
)
export (
  banded_mask_for_input,
  banded_positions_for_input,
  bidirectional_mask,
  bidirectional_mask_for_input,
  blocksparse_mask,
  causal_mask,
  causal_mask_for_input,
  mask_for_input,
  mask_length_for_input,
)

type Mask[B,K,C] = Tensor[B,K]

mask_for_input :: Tensor[B,Q] -> ?Mask[B,K,C] -> Dim -> ?Mask[B,K,C]
mask_for_input x mask capacity = mask

mask_length_for_input :: Tensor[B,Q] -> ?Mask[B,K,C] -> Dim -> Dim
mask_length_for_input x mask past_length = (mask == null) ? (past_length + Q) : K

-- === CAUSAL MASK ===
causal_mask_keep :: Tensor[B,HQ,Q,HDQ] -> Tensor[B,HK,K,HDK] -> ?Dim -> Tensor[B,1,Q,K]
causal_mask_keep q k ?window=null = do
  row_ids <- arange q start=0 end=Q |> reshape shape=[Q, 1]
  col_ids <- arange k start=0 end=K |> reshape shape=[1, K]
  aligned <- row_ids + (K - Q)
  upper <- le col_ids aligned
  keep_window <- (window == null) ? upper : (and upper (le (aligned - window + 1) col_ids))
  keep <- reshape keep_window shape=[1, 1, Q, K]
  return expand keep shape=[B, 1, Q, K]


causal_mask_masked :: Tensor[B,HQ,Q,HDQ] -> Tensor[B,HK,K,HDK] -> Tensor[B,K] -> ?Dim -> Tensor[B,1,Q,K]
causal_mask_masked q k attn_mask ?window=null = do
  keep <- causal_mask_keep q k window=window
  pad_keep <- cast attn_mask dtype="bool" |> reshape shape=[B, 1, 1, K]
  return and keep pad_keep


causal_mask :: Tensor[B,HQ,Q,HDQ] -> Tensor[B,HK,K,HDK] -> ?Tensor[B,K] -> ?Dim -> ?Bool -> Tensor[B,1,Q,K]
causal_mask q k ?padding_mask=null ?window=null ?early_exit=false = if padding_mask == null then
    causal_mask_keep q k window=window
  else
    causal_mask_masked q k padding_mask window=window


causal_mask_for_input_keep :: Tensor[B,Q] -> Dim -> ?Dim -> Tensor[B,1,Q,K]
causal_mask_for_input_keep x K ?window=null = do
  row_ids <- arange x start=0 end=Q |> reshape shape=[Q, 1]
  col_ids <- arange x start=0 end=K |> reshape shape=[1, K]
  aligned <- row_ids + (K - Q)
  upper <- le col_ids aligned
  keep_window <- (window == null) ? upper : (and upper (le (aligned - window + 1) col_ids))
  keep <- reshape keep_window shape=[1, 1, Q, K]
  return expand keep shape=[B, 1, Q, K]


causal_mask_for_input_masked :: Tensor[B,Q] -> Dim -> Tensor[B,K] -> ?Dim -> Tensor[B,1,Q,K]
causal_mask_for_input_masked x K padding_mask ?window=null = do
  keep <- causal_mask_for_input_keep x K window=window
  pad_keep <- cast padding_mask dtype="bool" |> reshape shape=[B, 1, 1, K]
  return and keep pad_keep


causal_mask_for_input :: Tensor[B,Q] -> Dim -> ?Tensor[B,K] -> ?Dim -> Tensor[B,1,Q,K]
causal_mask_for_input x K ?padding_mask=null ?window=null = if padding_mask == null then
    causal_mask_for_input_keep x K window=window
  else
    causal_mask_for_input_masked x K padding_mask window=window


-- === BIDIRECTIONAL MASK ===
bidirectional_mask_keep :: Tensor[B,HQ,Q,HDQ] -> Tensor[B,HK,K,HDK] -> ?Dim -> Tensor[B,1,Q,K]
bidirectional_mask_keep q k ?window=null = do
  row_ids <- arange q start=0 end=Q |> reshape shape=[Q, 1]
  col_ids <- arange k start=0 end=K |> reshape shape=[1, K]
  aligned <- row_ids + (K - Q)
  all_rows <- row_ids - row_ids
  all_cols <- col_ids - col_ids
  keep <- (window == null) ? eq all_rows all_cols : bidirectional_mask_keep_window aligned col_ids window
  keep <- reshape keep shape=[1, 1, Q, K]
  return expand keep shape=[B, 1, Q, K]


bidirectional_mask_keep_window :: Tensor[Q,K] -> Tensor[1,K] -> Dim -> Tensor[Q,K]
bidirectional_mask_keep_window aligned col_ids window = do
  return and (le col_ids (aligned + window)) (le (aligned - window) col_ids)


bidirectional_mask_masked :: Tensor[B,HQ,Q,HDQ] -> Tensor[B,HK,K,HDK] -> Tensor[B,SM] -> ?Dim -> Tensor[B,1,Q,K]
bidirectional_mask_masked q k attn_mask ?window=null = do
  keep <- bidirectional_mask_keep q k window=window
  pad_keep <- slice attn_mask dim=-1 start=(SM - K) end=SM |>
    cast dtype="bool" |>
    reshape shape=[B, 1, 1, K]
  return and keep pad_keep


bidirectional_mask :: Tensor[B,HQ,Q,HDQ] -> Tensor[B,HK,K,HDK] -> ?Tensor[B,SM] -> ?Dim -> Tensor[B,1,Q,K]
bidirectional_mask q k ?padding_mask=null ?window=null = if padding_mask == null then
    bidirectional_mask_keep q k window=window
  else
    bidirectional_mask_masked q k padding_mask window=window


bidirectional_mask_for_input_keep :: Tensor[B,Q] -> Dim -> ?Dim -> Tensor[B,1,Q,K]
bidirectional_mask_for_input_keep x K ?window=null = do
  row_ids <- arange x start=0 end=Q |> reshape shape=[Q, 1]
  col_ids <- arange x start=0 end=K |> reshape shape=[1, K]
  aligned <- row_ids + (K - Q)
  all_rows <- row_ids - row_ids
  all_cols <- col_ids - col_ids
  keep <- (window == null) ? eq all_rows all_cols : bidirectional_mask_keep_window aligned col_ids window
  keep <- reshape keep shape=[1, 1, Q, K]
  return expand keep shape=[B, 1, Q, K]


bidirectional_mask_for_input_masked :: Tensor[B,Q] -> Dim -> Tensor[B,K] -> ?Dim -> Tensor[B,1,Q,K]
bidirectional_mask_for_input_masked x K padding_mask ?window=null = do
  keep <- bidirectional_mask_for_input_keep x K window=window
  pad_keep <- slice padding_mask dim=-1 start=0 end=K |>
    cast dtype="bool" |>
    reshape shape=[B, 1, 1, K]
  return and keep pad_keep


bidirectional_mask_for_input :: Tensor[B,Q] -> Dim -> ?Tensor[B,K] -> ?Dim -> Tensor[B,1,Q,K]
bidirectional_mask_for_input x K ?padding_mask=null ?window=null = if padding_mask == null then
    bidirectional_mask_for_input_keep x K window=window
  else
    bidirectional_mask_for_input_masked x K padding_mask window=window


-- === BANDED MASK ===
-- Band position for query row t, slot w: pos[t, w] = t + w - left, with
-- w in [0, left + right + 1). Out-of-range slots are clamped into [0, S); the
-- paired validity mask kills the clamped duplicates, mirroring opf's
-- zero-pad + unfold + mask (the pad content is irrelevant there too).
banded_positions_for_input :: Tensor[B,Q] -> Dim -> Dim -> Dim -> (IdxTensor[S,W], Tensor[S,W])
banded_positions_for_input x S left right = do
  w <- ((left + right + 1) :: Dim)
  row_ids <- arange x start=0 end=S |> reshape shape=[S, 1]
  offsets <- arange x start=0 end=w |> reshape shape=[1, w]
  pos <- (row_ids + offsets) - left
  valid <- and (le 0 pos) (le pos (S - 1))
  pos_c <- clamp pos min=0 max=(S - 1)
  return (pos_c, valid)


-- Clamped band positions plus the combined keep mask: geometric validity ∧
-- key-side padding validity gathered at the clamped positions (queries are
-- never masked, matching opf's key_valid unfold).
banded_mask_for_input :: Tensor[B,Q] -> Dim -> Dim -> Dim -> ?Tensor[B,K] -> (IdxTensor[S,W], Tensor[B,S,W])
banded_mask_for_input x S left right ?padding_mask=null = do
  pos_c, valid <- banded_positions_for_input x S left right
  w <- ((left + right + 1) :: Dim)
  geo <- reshape valid shape=[1, S, w]
  keep <- (padding_mask == null)
    ? (expand geo shape=[B, S, w])
    : do
      sw <- ((S * w) :: Dim)
      idx <- reshape pos_c shape=[1, sw] |> expand shape=[B, sw]
      pad_keep <- cast padding_mask dtype="bool"
      pad_win <- gather pad_keep idx -1 |> reshape shape=[B, S, w]
      return and geo pad_win
  return (pos_c, keep)


-- === BLOCKSPARSE MASK ===
blocksparse_mask :: Tensor[B,H,Q,HD] -> Tensor[B,H,K,HD] -> ?Tensor[B,K] -> ?Dim -> ?Dim -> ?Dim -> ?Bool -> Tensor[B,H,Q,K]
blocksparse_mask q k ?padding_mask=null ?block_size=64 ?local_blocks=16 ?vert_stride=8 ?homo_head=false = do
  b <- size q dim=0
  h <- size q dim=1
  q_len <- size q dim=2
  k_len <- size k dim=2
  shift <- ((k_len - q_len) > 0) ? (k_len - q_len) : 0
  q_pos <- arange q start=0 end=q_len |> reshape shape=[q_len, 1]
  q_pos <- q_pos + shift
  k_pos <- arange k start=0 end=k_len |> reshape shape=[1, k_len]
  q_block <- floor (q_pos / block_size)
  k_block <- floor (k_pos / block_size)
  causal_token <- le k_pos q_pos
  causal_block <- le k_block q_block
  local_block <- le (q_block - (local_blocks - 1)) k_block
  keep <- homo_head
    ? do
      strided <- eq ((k_block + 1) % vert_stride) 0 |> expand shape=[q_len, k_len]
      local_or <- where local_block true strided
      keep_homo <- and causal_block local_or
      return reshape keep_homo shape=[1, 1, q_len, k_len]
    : do
      head_step_raw <- floor (vert_stride / (((h > 0) ? h : 1)))
      head_step <- (head_step_raw > 0) ? head_step_raw : 1
      head_idx <- arange q start=0 end=h |> reshape shape=[h, 1, 1]
      k_block_h <- reshape k_block shape=[1, 1, k_len]
      strided <- eq ((k_block_h + (head_idx * head_step) + 1) % vert_stride) 0 |> expand shape=[h, q_len, k_len]
      local_h <- reshape local_block shape=[1, q_len, k_len] |> expand shape=[h, q_len, k_len]
      causal_h <- reshape causal_block shape=[1, q_len, k_len] |> expand shape=[h, q_len, k_len]
      local_or <- where local_h true strided
      keep_h <- and causal_h local_or
      return reshape keep_h shape=[1, h, q_len, k_len]
  keep <- and keep (reshape causal_token shape=[1, 1, q_len, k_len])
  keep <- expand keep shape=[b, h, q_len, k_len]
  keep <- (padding_mask == null)
    ? keep
    : do
      pad_keep <- cast padding_mask dtype="bool" |> reshape shape=[b, 1, 1, k_len]
      return and keep pad_keep
  return where keep 0.0 (dtype_value q "min")
import Activations tanh
import Math sqrt
import Tensor (concat, slice, softmax)
export (
  attention,
  attention_gqa_banded,
  attention_gqa_with_additive_mask,
  attention_with_additive_mask,
  attention_scaled,
  attention_softcap,
  mask_to_additive_for_input,
  merge_heads,
  reshape_heads,
  split_qkv_grouped,
  split_qkv_heads,
)

-- === HEAD LAYOUT ===
reshape_heads :: Tensor[B,S,D] -> Dim -> Tensor[B,heads,S,D / heads]
reshape_heads x heads = do
  hd <- D / heads
  return Tensor.reshape x shape=[B, S, heads, hd] |> Tensor.permute dims=[0, 2, 1, 3]


merge_heads :: Tensor[B,heads,S,HD] -> Tensor[B,S,heads * HD]
merge_heads x = do
  y <- Tensor.permute x dims=[0, 2, 1, 3]
  h <- Tensor.size y dim=2
  hd <- Tensor.size y dim=3
  d <- h * hd
  return Tensor.reshape y shape=[B, S, d]


split_qkv_heads :: Tensor[B,T,D] -> ?Dim -> ?String -> (Tensor[B,H,T,HD], Tensor[B,H,T,HD], Tensor[B,H,T,HD])
split_qkv_heads x ?heads=1 ?layout="packed" = do
  hd <- D / (3 * heads)
  return (layout == "interleaved")
    ? do
      qkv <- Tensor.reshape x shape=[B, T, heads, 3, hd]
      q <- Tensor.slice qkv dim=3 start=0 end=1 |> Tensor.reshape shape=[B, T, heads, hd] |> Tensor.permute dims=[0, 2, 1, 3]
      k <- Tensor.slice qkv dim=3 start=1 end=2 |> Tensor.reshape shape=[B, T, heads, hd] |> Tensor.permute dims=[0, 2, 1, 3]
      v <- Tensor.slice qkv dim=3 start=2 end=3 |> Tensor.reshape shape=[B, T, heads, hd] |> Tensor.permute dims=[0, 2, 1, 3]
      return q, k, v
    : do
      q_lin, k_lin, v_lin <- Tensor.chunk x parts=3
      q <- reshape_heads q_lin heads
      k <- reshape_heads k_lin heads
      v <- reshape_heads v_lin heads
      return q, k, v


split_qkv_grouped :: Tensor[B,T,D] -> Dim -> Dim -> ?Dim -> (Tensor[B,heads,T,HD], Tensor[B,kv_heads,T,HD], Tensor[B,kv_heads,T,HD])
split_qkv_grouped x heads kv_heads ?head_dim=null = do
  q_per_kv <- ((heads / kv_heads) :: Dim)
  groups <- ((q_per_kv + 2) :: Dim)
  hd <- (((head_dim == null) ? (D / (kv_heads * groups)) : head_dim) :: Dim)
  grouped <- Tensor.reshape x shape=[B, T, kv_heads, groups, hd]
  q <- Tensor.slice grouped dim=3 start=0 end=q_per_kv |> Tensor.reshape shape=[B, T, heads, hd] |> Tensor.permute dims=[0, 2, 1, 3]
  k <- Tensor.slice grouped dim=3 start=q_per_kv end=(q_per_kv + 1) |> Tensor.reshape shape=[B, T, kv_heads, hd] |> Tensor.permute dims=[0, 2, 1, 3]
  v <- Tensor.slice grouped dim=3 start=(q_per_kv + 1) end=groups |> Tensor.reshape shape=[B, T, kv_heads, hd] |> Tensor.permute dims=[0, 2, 1, 3]
  return q, k, v


-- === ATTENTION ===
mask_to_additive :: Tensor[B,H,Q,K] -> Tensor[B,HM,Q,K] -> Tensor[B,H,Q,K]
mask_to_additive ref keep = Tensor.where keep (Tensor.zeros_like ref) (Tensor.min_like ref)


mask_to_additive_for_input :: Tensor[B,Q] -> Tensor[B,HM,Q,K] -> Dim -> ?String -> Tensor[B,heads,Q,K]
mask_to_additive_for_input ref keep heads ?dtype="float32" = do
  zero <- Tensor.zeros ref shape=[B, heads, Q, K] dtype=dtype
  return Tensor.where keep zero (Tensor.min_like zero)


attention :: Tensor[B,H,Q,HD] -> Tensor[B,H,K,HD] -> Tensor[B,H,K,VD] -> Tensor[B,HM,Q,K] -> ?Tensor[..RB] -> ?Float -> ?Tensor[B,H,Q,1] -> ?Float -> ?Bool -> ?Bool -> Tensor[B,H,Q,VD]
attention q k v keep ?rel_bias=null ?scale=null ?sink_logits=null ?softcap=null ?zero_masked_after_softmax=true ?fp32_compute=false = do
  scale_eff <- (scale == null) ? (1.0 / sqrt HD) : scale
  scores <- Tensor.matmul q (Tensor.transpose k dim1=2 dim2=3)
  scores <- scores * scale_eff
  softcap_val <- (softcap == null) ? 0.0 : softcap
  scores <- ((softcap == null) or (softcap_val == 0.0)) ? scores : do
    scaled <- scores / softcap_val
    squashed <- tanh scaled
    return squashed * softcap_val
  mask <- mask_to_additive scores keep
  probs_in <- scores + mask
  probs_in <- (rel_bias == null) ? probs_in : (probs_in + rel_bias)
  probs_in <- (sink_logits == null) ? probs_in : do
    combined <- concat probs_in sink_logits dim=-1
    row_max, _ <- Tensor.topk combined 1 dim=-1 largest=true sorted=false
    return combined - row_max
  probs <- fp32_compute ? (softmax probs_in dim=-1 dtype="float32") : (softmax probs_in dim=-1)
  K <- Tensor.size v dim=-2
  probs <- slice probs dim=-1 start=0 end=K
  probs <- (probs :: Tensor[B,H,Q,K])
  probs <- zero_masked_after_softmax ? (Tensor.where keep probs 0) : probs
  v_work <- fp32_compute ? (Tensor.cast v dtype="float32") : v
  out <- Tensor.matmul probs v_work
  return fp32_compute ? (Tensor.cast out dtype="float32") : out


attention_with_additive_mask :: Tensor[B,H,Q,HD] -> Tensor[B,H,K,HD] -> Tensor[B,H,K,VD] -> Tensor[B,H,Q,K] -> Tensor[B,HM,Q,K] -> ?Tensor[..RB] -> ?Float -> ?Tensor[B,H,Q,1] -> ?Float -> ?Bool -> ?Bool -> Tensor[B,H,Q,VD]
attention_with_additive_mask q k v mask keep ?rel_bias=null ?scale=null ?sink_logits=null ?softcap=null ?zero_masked_after_softmax=true ?fp32_compute=false = do
  scale_eff <- (scale == null) ? (1.0 / sqrt HD) : scale
  scores <- Tensor.matmul q (Tensor.transpose k dim1=2 dim2=3)
  scores <- scores * scale_eff
  softcap_val <- (softcap == null) ? 0.0 : softcap
  scores <- ((softcap == null) or (softcap_val == 0.0)) ? scores : do
    scaled <- scores / softcap_val
    squashed <- tanh scaled
    return squashed * softcap_val
  probs_in <- scores + mask
  probs_in <- (rel_bias == null) ? probs_in : (probs_in + rel_bias)
  probs_in <- (sink_logits == null) ? probs_in : do
    combined <- concat probs_in sink_logits dim=-1
    row_max, _ <- Tensor.topk combined 1 dim=-1 largest=true sorted=false
    return combined - row_max
  probs <- fp32_compute ? (softmax probs_in dim=-1 dtype="float32") : (softmax probs_in dim=-1)
  K <- Tensor.size v dim=-2
  probs <- slice probs dim=-1 start=0 end=K
  probs <- (probs :: Tensor[B,H,Q,K])
  probs <- zero_masked_after_softmax ? (Tensor.where keep probs 0) : probs
  v_work <- fp32_compute ? (Tensor.cast v dtype="float32") : v
  out <- Tensor.matmul probs v_work
  return fp32_compute ? (Tensor.cast out dtype="float32") : out


attention_gqa_apply_sink_logits :: Tensor[B,H,Q,1] -> Dim -> Tensor[B,KVH,G,Q,K] -> Tensor[B,KVH,G,Q,K]
attention_gqa_apply_sink_logits sink_logits groups probs_in = do
  sink_logits_g <- ((Tensor.reshape sink_logits shape=[B, KVH, groups, Q, 1]) :: Tensor[B,KVH,G,Q,1])
  combined <- concat probs_in sink_logits_g dim=-1
  row_max, _ <- Tensor.topk combined 1 dim=-1 largest=true sorted=false
  return combined - row_max


attention_gqa_with_additive_mask :: Tensor[B,H,Q,HD] -> Tensor[B,KVH,K,HD] -> Tensor[B,KVH,K,VD] -> Tensor[B,H,Q,K] -> Tensor[B,HM,Q,K] -> ?Tensor[..RB] -> ?Float -> ?Tensor[B,H,Q,1] -> ?Float -> ?Bool -> ?Bool -> Tensor[B,H,Q,VD]
attention_gqa_with_additive_mask q k v mask keep ?rel_bias=null ?scale=null ?sink_logits=null ?softcap=null ?zero_masked_after_softmax=true ?fp32_compute=false = do
  groups <- ((H / KVH) :: Dim)
  qg <- ((Tensor.reshape q shape=[B, KVH, groups, Q, HD]) :: Tensor[B,KVH,H / KVH,Q,HD])
  kg <- Tensor.unsqueeze k 2
  vg <- Tensor.unsqueeze v 2
  scale_eff <- (scale == null) ? (1.0 / sqrt HD) : scale
  scores <- Tensor.matmul qg (Tensor.transpose kg dim1=3 dim2=4)
  scores <- (scores :: Tensor[B,KVH,H / KVH,Q,K])
  scores <- scores * scale_eff
  softcap_val <- (softcap == null) ? 0.0 : softcap
  scores <- ((softcap == null) or (softcap_val == 0.0)) ? scores : do
    scaled <- scores / softcap_val
    squashed <- tanh scaled
    return squashed * softcap_val
  mask_g <- ((Tensor.reshape mask shape=[B, KVH, groups, Q, K]) :: Tensor[B,KVH,H / KVH,Q,K])
  probs_in <- scores + mask_g
  probs_in <- (rel_bias == null) ? probs_in : (probs_in + (Tensor.reshape rel_bias shape=[B, KVH, groups, Q, K]))
  probs_in <- (sink_logits == null) ? probs_in : attention_gqa_apply_sink_logits sink_logits groups probs_in
  probs <- fp32_compute ? (softmax probs_in dim=-1 dtype="float32") : (softmax probs_in dim=-1)
  K <- Tensor.size v dim=-2
  probs <- slice probs dim=-1 start=0 end=K
  probs <- (probs :: Tensor[B,KVH,H / KVH,Q,K])
  keep_g <- Tensor.reshape keep shape=[B, 1, 1, Q, K] |> Tensor.expand shape=[B, KVH, groups, Q, K]
  probs <- zero_masked_after_softmax ? (Tensor.where keep_g probs 0) : probs
  v_work <- fp32_compute ? (Tensor.cast vg dtype="float32") : vg
  out <- Tensor.matmul probs v_work
  out <- (out :: Tensor[B,KVH,H / KVH,Q,VD])
  out <- Tensor.reshape out shape=[B, H, Q, VD]
  return fp32_compute ? (Tensor.cast out dtype="float32") : out


-- Banded local GQA attention, one-to-one with opf's unfold kernel (the sdpa
-- banded path): K/V are gathered into per-query windows of W = left + right + 1
-- positions, so scores are [.., S, W] instead of [.., S, S]. band_idx/keep come
-- from Masking.banded_mask_for_input; clamped duplicate slots are killed by
-- keep, mirroring opf's zero-pad + mask. No rel_bias/softcap: positions are
-- RoPE-applied before banding, which is what makes the window gather correct.
attention_gqa_banded :: Tensor[B,H,S,HD] -> Tensor[B,KVH,S,HD] -> Tensor[B,KVH,S,VD] -> IdxTensor[S,W] -> Tensor[B,S,W] -> ?Float -> ?Tensor[B,H,S,1] -> ?Bool -> ?Bool -> Tensor[B,H,S,VD]
attention_gqa_banded q k v band_idx keep ?scale=null ?sink_logits=null ?zero_masked_after_softmax=true ?fp32_compute=false = do
  groups <- ((H / KVH) :: Dim)
  sw <- ((S * W) :: Dim)
  idx_col <- Tensor.reshape band_idx shape=[1, 1, sw, 1]
  kwin <- Tensor.gather k (Tensor.expand idx_col shape=[B, KVH, sw, HD]) dim=2 |> Tensor.reshape shape=[B, KVH, S, W, HD]
  vwin <- Tensor.gather v (Tensor.expand idx_col shape=[B, KVH, sw, VD]) dim=2 |> Tensor.reshape shape=[B, KVH, S, W, VD]
  qg <- ((Tensor.reshape q shape=[B, KVH, groups, S, 1, HD]) :: Tensor[B,KVH,H / KVH,S,1,HD])
  kg <- Tensor.unsqueeze kwin 2
  vg <- Tensor.unsqueeze vwin 2
  scale_eff <- (scale == null) ? (1.0 / sqrt HD) : scale
  scores <- Tensor.matmul qg (Tensor.transpose kg dim1=4 dim2=5)
  scores <- Tensor.reshape scores shape=[B, KVH, groups, S, W]
  scores <- (scores :: Tensor[B,KVH,H / KVH,S,W])
  scores <- scores * scale_eff
  zero <- Tensor.zeros q shape=[B, 1, 1, S, W] dtype="float32"
  keep_b <- Tensor.reshape keep shape=[B, 1, 1, S, W]
  mask_g <- Tensor.where keep_b zero (Tensor.min_like zero)
  probs_in <- scores + mask_g
  probs_in <- (sink_logits == null) ? probs_in : attention_gqa_apply_sink_logits sink_logits groups probs_in
  probs <- fp32_compute ? (softmax probs_in dim=-1 dtype="float32") : (softmax probs_in dim=-1)
  probs <- slice probs dim=-1 start=0 end=W
  probs <- (probs :: Tensor[B,KVH,H / KVH,S,W])
  keep_g <- Tensor.expand keep_b shape=[B, KVH, groups, S, W]
  probs <- zero_masked_after_softmax ? (Tensor.where keep_g probs 0) : probs
  v_work <- fp32_compute ? (Tensor.cast vg dtype="float32") : vg
  probs6 <- Tensor.reshape probs shape=[B, KVH, groups, S, 1, W]
  out <- Tensor.matmul probs6 v_work
  out <- (out :: Tensor[B,KVH,H / KVH,S,1,VD])
  out <- Tensor.reshape out shape=[B, H, S, VD]
  return fp32_compute ? (Tensor.cast out dtype="float32") : out


attention_scaled :: Tensor[B,H,Q,HD] -> Tensor[B,H,K,HD] -> Tensor[B,H,K,VD] -> Tensor[B,HM,Q,K] -> Float -> Tensor[B,H,Q,VD]
attention_scaled q k v keep scale = do
  scores <- Tensor.matmul q (Tensor.transpose k dim1=2 dim2=3)
  scores <- scores * scale
  mask <- mask_to_additive scores keep
  probs_in <- scores + mask
  probs <- softmax probs_in dim=-1
  probs <- Tensor.where keep probs 0
  return Tensor.matmul probs v


attention_softcap :: Tensor[B,H,Q,HD] -> Tensor[B,H,K,HD] -> Tensor[B,H,K,VD] -> Tensor[B,HM,Q,K] -> Float -> Float -> Tensor[B,H,Q,VD]
attention_softcap q k v keep softcap scale = do
  scores <- Tensor.matmul q (Tensor.transpose k dim1=2 dim2=3)
  scores <- scores * scale
  scaled <- scores / softcap
  squashed <- tanh scaled
  scores <- squashed * softcap
  mask <- mask_to_additive scores keep
  probs_in <- scores + mask
  probs <- softmax probs_in dim=-1 dtype="float32"
  out <- Tensor.matmul probs (Tensor.cast v dtype="float32")
  return Tensor.cast out dtype="float32"

type Mask[B,K,C] = Tensor[B,K]

mask_for_input :: Tensor[B,Q] -> ?Mask[B,K,C] -> Dim -> ?Mask[B,K,C]
mask_for_input x mask capacity = mask

mask_length_for_input :: Tensor[B,Q] -> ?Mask[B,K,C] -> Dim -> Dim
mask_length_for_input x mask past_length = (mask == null) ? (past_length + Q) : K

-- === CAUSAL MASK ===
causal_mask_keep :: Tensor[B,HQ,Q,HDQ] -> Tensor[B,HK,K,HDK] -> ?Dim -> Tensor[B,1,Q,K]
causal_mask_keep q k ?window=null = do
  row_ids <- arange q start=0 end=Q |> reshape shape=[Q, 1]
  col_ids <- arange k start=0 end=K |> reshape shape=[1, K]
  aligned <- row_ids + (K - Q)
  upper <- le col_ids aligned
  keep_window <- (window == null) ? upper : (and upper (le (aligned - window + 1) col_ids))
  keep <- reshape keep_window shape=[1, 1, Q, K]
  return expand keep shape=[B, 1, Q, K]


causal_mask_masked :: Tensor[B,HQ,Q,HDQ] -> Tensor[B,HK,K,HDK] -> Tensor[B,K] -> ?Dim -> Tensor[B,1,Q,K]
causal_mask_masked q k attn_mask ?window=null = do
  keep <- causal_mask_keep q k window=window
  pad_keep <- cast attn_mask dtype="bool" |> reshape shape=[B, 1, 1, K]
  return and keep pad_keep


causal_mask :: Tensor[B,HQ,Q,HDQ] -> Tensor[B,HK,K,HDK] -> ?Tensor[B,K] -> ?Dim -> ?Bool -> Tensor[B,1,Q,K]
causal_mask q k ?padding_mask=null ?window=null ?early_exit=false = if padding_mask == null then
    causal_mask_keep q k window=window
  else
    causal_mask_masked q k padding_mask window=window


causal_mask_for_input_keep :: Tensor[B,Q] -> Dim -> ?Dim -> Tensor[B,1,Q,K]
causal_mask_for_input_keep x K ?window=null = do
  row_ids <- arange x start=0 end=Q |> reshape shape=[Q, 1]
  col_ids <- arange x start=0 end=K |> reshape shape=[1, K]
  aligned <- row_ids + (K - Q)
  upper <- le col_ids aligned
  keep_window <- (window == null) ? upper : (and upper (le (aligned - window + 1) col_ids))
  keep <- reshape keep_window shape=[1, 1, Q, K]
  return expand keep shape=[B, 1, Q, K]


causal_mask_for_input_masked :: Tensor[B,Q] -> Dim -> Tensor[B,K] -> ?Dim -> Tensor[B,1,Q,K]
causal_mask_for_input_masked x K padding_mask ?window=null = do
  keep <- causal_mask_for_input_keep x K window=window
  pad_keep <- cast padding_mask dtype="bool" |> reshape shape=[B, 1, 1, K]
  return and keep pad_keep


causal_mask_for_input :: Tensor[B,Q] -> Dim -> ?Tensor[B,K] -> ?Dim -> Tensor[B,1,Q,K]
causal_mask_for_input x K ?padding_mask=null ?window=null = if padding_mask == null then
    causal_mask_for_input_keep x K window=window
  else

-- === BIDIRECTIONAL MASK ===
bidirectional_mask_keep :: Tensor[B,HQ,Q,HDQ] -> Tensor[B,HK,K,HDK] -> ?Dim -> Tensor[B,1,Q,K]
bidirectional_mask_keep q k ?window=null = do
  row_ids <- arange q start=0 end=Q |> reshape shape=[Q, 1]
  col_ids <- arange k start=0 end=K |> reshape shape=[1, K]
  aligned <- row_ids + (K - Q)
  all_rows <- row_ids - row_ids
  all_cols <- col_ids - col_ids
  keep <- (window == null) ? eq all_rows all_cols : bidirectional_mask_keep_window aligned col_ids window
  keep <- reshape keep shape=[1, 1, Q, K]
  return expand keep shape=[B, 1, Q, K]


bidirectional_mask_keep_window :: Tensor[Q,K] -> Tensor[1,K] -> Dim -> Tensor[Q,K]
bidirectional_mask_keep_window aligned col_ids window = do
  return and (le col_ids (aligned + window)) (le (aligned - window) col_ids)


bidirectional_mask_masked :: Tensor[B,HQ,Q,HDQ] -> Tensor[B,HK,K,HDK] -> Tensor[B,SM] -> ?Dim -> Tensor[B,1,Q,K]
bidirectional_mask_masked q k attn_mask ?window=null = do
  keep <- bidirectional_mask_keep q k window=window
  pad_keep <- slice attn_mask dim=-1 start=(SM - K) end=SM |>
    cast dtype="bool" |>
    reshape shape=[B, 1, 1, K]
  return and keep pad_keep


bidirectional_mask :: Tensor[B,HQ,Q,HDQ] -> Tensor[B,HK,K,HDK] -> ?Tensor[B,SM] -> ?Dim -> Tensor[B,1,Q,K]
bidirectional_mask q k ?padding_mask=null ?window=null = if padding_mask == null then
    bidirectional_mask_keep q k window=window
  else
    bidirectional_mask_masked q k padding_mask window=window


bidirectional_mask_for_input_keep :: Tensor[B,Q] -> Dim -> ?Dim -> Tensor[B,1,Q,K]
bidirectional_mask_for_input_keep x K ?window=null = do
  row_ids <- arange x start=0 end=Q |> reshape shape=[Q, 1]
  col_ids <- arange x start=0 end=K |> reshape shape=[1, K]
  aligned <- row_ids + (K - Q)
  all_rows <- row_ids - row_ids
  all_cols <- col_ids - col_ids
  keep <- (window == null) ? eq all_rows all_cols : bidirectional_mask_keep_window aligned col_ids window
  keep <- reshape keep shape=[1, 1, Q, K]
  return expand keep shape=[B, 1, Q, K]


bidirectional_mask_for_input_masked :: Tensor[B,Q] -> Dim -> Tensor[B,K] -> ?Dim -> Tensor[B,1,Q,K]
bidirectional_mask_for_input_masked x K padding_mask ?window=null = do
  keep <- bidirectional_mask_for_input_keep x K window=window
  pad_keep <- slice padding_mask dim=-1 start=0 end=K |>
    cast dtype="bool" |>
    reshape shape=[B, 1, 1, K]
  return and keep pad_keep


bidirectional_mask_for_input :: Tensor[B,Q] -> Dim -> ?Tensor[B,K] -> ?Dim -> Tensor[B,1,Q,K]
bidirectional_mask_for_input x K ?padding_mask=null ?window=null = if padding_mask == null then
    bidirectional_mask_for_input_keep x K window=window
  else
    bidirectional_mask_for_input_masked x K padding_mask window=window


-- === BANDED MASK ===
-- Band position for query row t, slot w: pos[t, w] = t + w - left, with
-- w in [0, left + right + 1). Out-of-range slots are clamped into [0, S); the
-- paired validity mask kills the clamped duplicates, mirroring opf's
-- zero-pad + unfold + mask (the pad content is irrelevant there too).
banded_positions_for_input :: Tensor[B,Q] -> Dim -> Dim -> Dim -> (IdxTensor[S,W], Tensor[S,W])
banded_positions_for_input x S left right = do
  w <- ((left + right + 1) :: Dim)
  row_ids <- arange x start=0 end=S |> reshape shape=[S, 1]
  offsets <- arange x start=0 end=w |> reshape shape=[1, w]
  pos <- (row_ids + offsets) - left
  valid <- and (le 0 pos) (le pos (S - 1))
  pos_c <- clamp pos min=0 max=(S - 1)
  return (pos_c, valid)


-- Clamped band positions plus the combined keep mask: geometric validity ∧
-- key-side padding validity gathered at the clamped positions (queries are
-- never masked, matching opf's key_valid unfold).
banded_mask_for_input :: Tensor[B,Q] -> Dim -> Dim -> Dim -> ?Tensor[B,K] -> (IdxTensor[S,W], Tensor[B,S,W])
banded_mask_for_input x S left right ?padding_mask=null = do
  pos_c, valid <- banded_positions_for_input x S left right
  w <- ((left + right + 1) :: Dim)
  geo <- reshape valid shape=[1, S, w]
  keep <- (padding_mask == null)
    ? (expand geo shape=[B, S, w])
    : do
      sw <- ((S * w) :: Dim)
      idx <- reshape pos_c shape=[1, sw] |> expand shape=[B, sw]
      pad_keep <- cast padding_mask dtype="bool"
      pad_win <- gather pad_keep idx -1 |> reshape shape=[B, S, w]
      return and geo pad_win
  return (pos_c, keep)


-- === BLOCKSPARSE MASK ===
blocksparse_mask :: Tensor[B,H,Q,HD] -> Tensor[B,H,K,HD] -> ?Tensor[B,K] -> ?Dim -> ?Dim -> ?Dim -> ?Bool -> Tensor[B,H,Q,K]
blocksparse_mask q k ?padding_mask=null ?block_size=64 ?local_blocks=16 ?vert_stride=8 ?homo_head=false = do
  b <- size q dim=0
  h <- size q dim=1
  q_len <- size q dim=2
  k_len <- size k dim=2
  shift <- ((k_len - q_len) > 0) ? (k_len - q_len) : 0
  q_pos <- arange q start=0 end=q_len |> reshape shape=[q_len, 1]
  q_pos <- q_pos + shift
  k_pos <- arange k start=0 end=k_len |> reshape shape=[1, k_len]
  q_block <- floor (q_pos / block_size)
  k_block <- floor (k_pos / block_size)
  causal_token <- le k_pos q_pos
  causal_block <- le k_block q_block
  local_block <- le (q_block - (local_blocks - 1)) k_block
  keep <- homo_head
    ? do
      strided <- eq ((k_block + 1) % vert_stride) 0 |> expand shape=[q_len, k_len]
      local_or <- where local_block true strided
      keep_homo <- and causal_block local_or
      return reshape keep_homo shape=[1, 1, q_len, k_len]
    : do
      head_step_raw <- floor (vert_stride / (((h > 0) ? h : 1)))
      head_step <- (head_step_raw > 0) ? head_step_raw : 1
      head_idx <- arange q start=0 end=h |> reshape shape=[h, 1, 1]
      k_block_h <- reshape k_block shape=[1, 1, k_len]
      strided <- eq ((k_block_h + (head_idx * head_step) + 1) % vert_stride) 0 |> expand shape=[h, q_len, k_len]
      local_h <- reshape local_block shape=[1, q_len, k_len] |> expand shape=[h, q_len, k_len]
      causal_h <- reshape causal_block shape=[1, q_len, k_len] |> expand shape=[h, q_len, k_len]
      local_or <- where local_h true strided
      keep_h <- and causal_h local_or
      return reshape keep_h shape=[1, h, q_len, k_len]
  keep <- and keep (reshape causal_token shape=[1, 1, q_len, k_len])
  keep <- expand keep shape=[b, h, q_len, k_len]
  keep <- (padding_mask == null)
    ? keep
    : do
      pad_keep <- cast padding_mask dtype="bool" |> reshape shape=[b, 1, 1, k_len]
      return and keep pad_keep
  return where keep 0.0 (dtype_value q "min")
import Activations tanh
import Math sqrt
import Tensor (concat, slice, softmax)
export (
  attention,
  attention_gqa_banded,
  attention_gqa_with_additive_mask,
  attention_with_additive_mask,
  attention_scaled,
  attention_softcap,
  mask_to_additive_for_input,
  merge_heads,
  reshape_heads,
  split_qkv_grouped,
  split_qkv_heads,
)

-- === HEAD LAYOUT ===
reshape_heads :: Tensor[B,S,D] -> Dim -> Tensor[B,heads,S,D / heads]
reshape_heads x heads = do
  hd <- D / heads
  return Tensor.reshape x shape=[B, S, heads, hd] |> Tensor.permute dims=[0, 2, 1, 3]


merge_heads :: Tensor[B,heads,S,HD] -> Tensor[B,S,heads * HD]
merge_heads x = do
  y <- Tensor.permute x dims=[0, 2, 1, 3]
  h <- Tensor.size y dim=2
  hd <- Tensor.size y dim=3
  d <- h * hd
  return Tensor.reshape y shape=[B, S, d]


split_qkv_heads :: Tensor[B,T,D] -> ?Dim -> ?String -> (Tensor[B,H,T,HD], Tensor[B,H,T,HD], Tensor[B,H,T,HD])
split_qkv_heads x ?heads=1 ?layout="packed" = do
  hd <- D / (3 * heads)
  return (layout == "interleaved")
    ? do
      qkv <- Tensor.reshape x shape=[B, T, heads, 3, hd]
      q <- Tensor.slice qkv dim=3 start=0 end=1 |> Tensor.reshape shape=[B, T, heads, hd] |> Tensor.permute dims=[0, 2, 1, 3]
      k <- Tensor.slice qkv dim=3 start=1 end=2 |> Tensor.reshape shape=[B, T, heads, hd] |> Tensor.permute dims=[0, 2, 1, 3]
      v <- Tensor.slice qkv dim=3 start=2 end=3 |> Tensor.reshape shape=[B, T, heads, hd] |> Tensor.permute dims=[0, 2, 1, 3]
      return q, k, v
    : do
      q_lin, k_lin, v_lin <- Tensor.chunk x parts=3
      q <- reshape_heads q_lin heads
      k <- reshape_heads k_lin heads
      v <- reshape_heads v_lin heads
      return q, k, v


split_qkv_grouped :: Tensor[B,T,D] -> Dim -> Dim -> ?Dim -> (Tensor[B,heads,T,HD], Tensor[B,kv_heads,T,HD], Tensor[B,kv_heads,T,HD])
split_qkv_grouped x heads kv_heads ?head_dim=null = do
  q_per_kv <- ((heads / kv_heads) :: Dim)
  groups <- ((q_per_kv + 2) :: Dim)
  hd <- (((head_dim == null) ? (D / (kv_heads * groups)) : head_dim) :: Dim)
  grouped <- Tensor.reshape x shape=[B, T, kv_heads, groups, hd]
  q <- Tensor.slice grouped dim=3 start=0 end=q_per_kv |> Tensor.reshape shape=[B, T, heads, hd] |> Tensor.permute dims=[0, 2, 1, 3]
  k <- Tensor.slice grouped dim=3 start=q_per_kv end=(q_per_kv + 1) |> Tensor.reshape shape=[B, T, kv_heads, hd] |> Tensor.permute dims=[0, 2, 1, 3]
  v <- Tensor.slice grouped dim=3 start=(q_per_kv + 1) end=groups |> Tensor.reshape shape=[B, T, kv_heads, hd] |> Tensor.permute dims=[0, 2, 1, 3]
  return q, k, v


-- === ATTENTION ===
mask_to_additive :: Tensor[B,H,Q,K] -> Tensor[B,HM,Q,K] -> Tensor[B,H,Q,K]
mask_to_additive ref keep = Tensor.where keep (Tensor.zeros_like ref) (Tensor.min_like ref)


mask_to_additive_for_input :: Tensor[B,Q] -> Tensor[B,HM,Q,K] -> Dim -> ?String -> Tensor[B,heads,Q,K]
mask_to_additive_for_input ref keep heads ?dtype="float32" = do
  zero <- Tensor.zeros ref shape=[B, heads, Q, K] dtype=dtype
  return Tensor.where keep zero (Tensor.min_like zero)


attention :: Tensor[B,H,Q,HD] -> Tensor[B,H,K,HD] -> Tensor[B,H,K,VD] -> Tensor[B,HM,Q,K] -> ?Tensor[..RB] -> ?Float -> ?Tensor[B,H,Q,1] -> ?Float -> ?Bool -> ?Bool -> Tensor[B,H,Q,VD]
attention q k v keep ?rel_bias=null ?scale=null ?sink_logits=null ?softcap=null ?zero_masked_after_softmax=true ?fp32_compute=false = do
  scale_eff <- (scale == null) ? (1.0 / sqrt HD) : scale
  scores <- Tensor.matmul q (Tensor.transpose k dim1=2 dim2=3)
  scores <- scores * scale_eff
  softcap_val <- (softcap == null) ? 0.0 : softcap
  scores <- ((softcap == null) or (softcap_val == 0.0)) ? scores : do
    scaled <- scores / softcap_val
    squashed <- tanh scaled
    return squashed * softcap_val
  mask <- mask_to_additive scores keep
  probs_in <- scores + mask
  probs_in <- (rel_bias == null) ? probs_in : (probs_in + rel_bias)
  probs_in <- (sink_logits == null) ? probs_in : do
    combined <- concat probs_in sink_logits dim=-1
    row_max, _ <- Tensor.topk combined 1 dim=-1 largest=true sorted=false
    return combined - row_max
  probs <- fp32_compute ? (softmax probs_in dim=-1 dtype="float32") : (softmax probs_in dim=-1)
  K <- Tensor.size v dim=-2
  probs <- slice probs dim=-1 start=0 end=K
  probs <- (probs :: Tensor[B,H,Q,K])
  probs <- zero_masked_after_softmax ? (Tensor.where keep probs 0) : probs
  v_work <- fp32_compute ? (Tensor.cast v dtype="float32") : v
  out <- Tensor.matmul probs v_work
  return fp32_compute ? (Tensor.cast out dtype="float32") : out


attention_with_additive_mask :: Tensor[B,H,Q,HD] -> Tensor[B,H,K,HD] -> Tensor[B,H,K,VD] -> Tensor[B,H,Q,K] -> Tensor[B,HM,Q,K] -> ?Tensor[..RB] -> ?Float -> ?Tensor[B,H,Q,1] -> ?Float -> ?Bool -> ?Bool -> Tensor[B,H,Q,VD]
attention_with_additive_mask q k v mask keep ?rel_bias=null ?scale=null ?sink_logits=null ?softcap=null ?zero_masked_after_softmax=true ?fp32_compute=false = do
  scale_eff <- (scale == null) ? (1.0 / sqrt HD) : scale
  scores <- Tensor.matmul q (Tensor.transpose k dim1=2 dim2=3)
  scores <- scores * scale_eff
  softcap_val <- (softcap == null) ? 0.0 : softcap
  scores <- ((softcap == null) or (softcap_val == 0.0)) ? scores : do
    scaled <- scores / softcap_val
    squashed <- tanh scaled
    return squashed * softcap_val
  probs_in <- scores + mask
  probs_in <- (rel_bias == null) ? probs_in : (probs_in + rel_bias)
  probs_in <- (sink_logits == null) ? probs_in : do
    combined <- concat probs_in sink_logits dim=-1
    row_max, _ <- Tensor.topk combined 1 dim=-1 largest=true sorted=false
    return combined - row_max
  probs <- fp32_compute ? (softmax probs_in dim=-1 dtype="float32") : (softmax probs_in dim=-1)
  K <- Tensor.size v dim=-2
  probs <- slice probs dim=-1 start=0 end=K
  probs <- (probs :: Tensor[B,H,Q,K])
  probs <- zero_masked_after_softmax ? (Tensor.where keep probs 0) : probs
  v_work <- fp32_compute ? (Tensor.cast v dtype="float32") : v
  out <- Tensor.matmul probs v_work
  return fp32_compute ? (Tensor.cast out dtype="float32") : out


attention_gqa_apply_sink_logits :: Tensor[B,H,Q,1] -> Dim -> Tensor[B,KVH,G,Q,K] -> Tensor[B,KVH,G,Q,K]
attention_gqa_apply_sink_logits sink_logits groups probs_in = do
  sink_logits_g <- ((Tensor.reshape sink_logits shape=[B, KVH, groups, Q, 1]) :: Tensor[B,KVH,G,Q,1])
  combined <- concat probs_in sink_logits_g dim=-1
  row_max, _ <- Tensor.topk combined 1 dim=-1 largest=true sorted=false
  return combined - row_max


attention_gqa_with_additive_mask :: Tensor[B,H,Q,HD] -> Tensor[B,KVH,K,HD] -> Tensor[B,KVH,K,VD] -> Tensor[B,H,Q,K] -> Tensor[B,HM,Q,K] -> ?Tensor[..RB] -> ?Float -> ?Tensor[B,H,Q,1] -> ?Float -> ?Bool -> ?Bool -> Tensor[B,H,Q,VD]
attention_gqa_with_additive_mask q k v mask keep ?rel_bias=null ?scale=null ?sink_logits=null ?softcap=null ?zero_masked_after_softmax=true ?fp32_compute=false = do
  groups <- ((H / KVH) :: Dim)
  qg <- ((Tensor.reshape q shape=[B, KVH, groups, Q, HD]) :: Tensor[B,KVH,H / KVH,Q,HD])
  kg <- Tensor.unsqueeze k 2
  vg <- Tensor.unsqueeze v 2
  scale_eff <- (scale == null) ? (1.0 / sqrt HD) : scale
  scores <- Tensor.matmul qg (Tensor.transpose kg dim1=3 dim2=4)
  scores <- (scores :: Tensor[B,KVH,H / KVH,Q,K])
  scores <- scores * scale_eff
  softcap_val <- (softcap == null) ? 0.0 : softcap
  scores <- ((softcap == null) or (softcap_val == 0.0)) ? scores : do
    scaled <- scores / softcap_val
    squashed <- tanh scaled
    return squashed * softcap_val
  mask_g <- ((Tensor.reshape mask shape=[B, KVH, groups, Q, K]) :: Tensor[B,KVH,H / KVH,Q,K])
  probs_in <- scores + mask_g
  probs_in <- (rel_bias == null) ? probs_in : (probs_in + (Tensor.reshape rel_bias shape=[B, KVH, groups, Q, K]))
  probs_in <- (sink_logits == null) ? probs_in : attention_gqa_apply_sink_logits sink_logits groups probs_in
  probs <- fp32_compute ? (softmax probs_in dim=-1 dtype="float32") : (softmax probs_in dim=-1)
  K <- Tensor.size v dim=-2
  probs <- slice probs dim=-1 start=0 end=K
  probs <- (probs :: Tensor[B,KVH,H / KVH,Q,K])
  keep_g <- Tensor.reshape keep shape=[B, 1, 1, Q, K] |> Tensor.expand shape=[B, KVH, groups, Q, K]
  probs <- zero_masked_after_softmax ? (Tensor.where keep_g probs 0) : probs
  v_work <- fp32_compute ? (Tensor.cast vg dtype="float32") : vg
  out <- Tensor.matmul probs v_work
  out <- (out :: Tensor[B,KVH,H / KVH,Q,VD])
  out <- Tensor.reshape out shape=[B, H, Q, VD]
  return fp32_compute ? (Tensor.cast out dtype="float32") : out


-- Banded local GQA attention, one-to-one with opf's unfold kernel (the sdpa
-- banded path): K/V are gathered into per-query windows of W = left + right + 1
-- positions, so scores are [.., S, W] instead of [.., S, S]. band_idx/keep come
-- from Masking.banded_mask_for_input; clamped duplicate slots are killed by
-- keep, mirroring opf's zero-pad + mask. No rel_bias/softcap: positions are
-- RoPE-applied before banding, which is what makes the window gather correct.
attention_gqa_banded :: Tensor[B,H,S,HD] -> Tensor[B,KVH,S,HD] -> Tensor[B,KVH,S,VD] -> IdxTensor[S,W] -> Tensor[B,S,W] -> ?Float -> ?Tensor[B,H,S,1] -> ?Bool -> ?Bool -> Tensor[B,H,S,VD]
attention_gqa_banded q k v band_idx keep ?scale=null ?sink_logits=null ?zero_masked_after_softmax=true ?fp32_compute=false = do
  groups <- ((H / KVH) :: Dim)
  sw <- ((S * W) :: Dim)
  idx_col <- Tensor.reshape band_idx shape=[1, 1, sw, 1]
  kwin <- Tensor.gather k (Tensor.expand idx_col shape=[B, KVH, sw, HD]) dim=2 |> Tensor.reshape shape=[B, KVH, S, W, HD]
  vwin <- Tensor.gather v (Tensor.expand idx_col shape=[B, KVH, sw, VD]) dim=2 |> Tensor.reshape shape=[B, KVH, S, W, VD]
  qg <- ((Tensor.reshape q shape=[B, KVH, groups, S, 1, HD]) :: Tensor[B,KVH,H / KVH,S,1,HD])
  kg <- Tensor.unsqueeze kwin 2
  vg <- Tensor.unsqueeze vwin 2
  scale_eff <- (scale == null) ? (1.0 / sqrt HD) : scale
  scores <- Tensor.matmul qg (Tensor.transpose kg dim1=4 dim2=5)
  scores <- Tensor.reshape scores shape=[B, KVH, groups, S, W]
  scores <- (scores :: Tensor[B,KVH,H / KVH,S,W])
  scores <- scores * scale_eff
  zero <- Tensor.zeros q shape=[B, 1, 1, S, W] dtype="float32"
  keep_b <- Tensor.reshape keep shape=[B, 1, 1, S, W]
  mask_g <- Tensor.where keep_b zero (Tensor.min_like zero)
  probs_in <- scores + mask_g
  probs_in <- (sink_logits == null) ? probs_in : attention_gqa_apply_sink_logits sink_logits groups probs_in
  probs <- fp32_compute ? (softmax probs_in dim=-1 dtype="float32") : (softmax probs_in dim=-1)
  probs <- slice probs dim=-1 start=0 end=W
  probs <- (probs :: Tensor[B,KVH,H / KVH,S,W])
  keep_g <- Tensor.expand keep_b shape=[B, KVH, groups, S, W]
  probs <- zero_masked_after_softmax ? (Tensor.where keep_g probs 0) : probs
  v_work <- fp32_compute ? (Tensor.cast vg dtype="float32") : vg
  probs6 <- Tensor.reshape probs shape=[B, KVH, groups, S, 1, W]
  out <- Tensor.matmul probs6 v_work
  out <- (out :: Tensor[B,KVH,H / KVH,S,1,VD])
  out <- Tensor.reshape out shape=[B, H, S, VD]
  return fp32_compute ? (Tensor.cast out dtype="float32") : out


attention_scaled :: Tensor[B,H,Q,HD] -> Tensor[B,H,K,HD] -> Tensor[B,H,K,VD] -> Tensor[B,HM,Q,K] -> Float -> Tensor[B,H,Q,VD]
attention_scaled q k v keep scale = do
  scores <- Tensor.matmul q (Tensor.transpose k dim1=2 dim2=3)
  scores <- scores * scale
  mask <- mask_to_additive scores keep
  probs_in <- scores + mask
  probs <- softmax probs_in dim=-1
  probs <- Tensor.where keep probs 0
  return Tensor.matmul probs v


attention_softcap :: Tensor[B,H,Q,HD] -> Tensor[B,H,K,HD] -> Tensor[B,H,K,VD] -> Tensor[B,HM,Q,K] -> Float -> Float -> Tensor[B,H,Q,VD]
attention_softcap q k v keep softcap scale = do
  scores <- Tensor.matmul q (Tensor.transpose k dim1=2 dim2=3)
  scores <- scores * scale
  scaled <- scores / softcap
  squashed <- tanh scaled
  scores <- squashed * softcap
  mask <- mask_to_additive scores keep
  probs_in <- scores + mask
  probs <- softmax probs_in dim=-1 dtype="float32"
  out <- Tensor.matmul probs (Tensor.cast v dtype="float32")
  return Tensor.cast out dtype="float32"

import List
import Tensor
export (
  append,
  append_any,
  append_kv,
  index,
  index_any,
  index_kv,
  finish_any,
  past_length,
  past_length_any,
  past_length_kv,
  prepare,
  prepare_any,
  prepare_kv,
  read,
  read_any,
  read_kv,
  finish,
  finish_kv,
  update,
  update_kv,
)

type CacheLayer[B,H,T,C,DH] = (Tensor[B,H,T,DH], Tensor[B,H,T,DH])
type Cache[B,H,T,C,DH] = List[(Tensor[B,H,T,DH], Tensor[B,H,T,DH])]
type CacheLayerKV[B,H,T,C,DK,DV] = (Tensor[B,H,T,DK], Tensor[B,H,T,DV])
type CacheKV[B,H,T,C,DK,DV] = List[(Tensor[B,H,T,DK], Tensor[B,H,T,DV])]
type CacheAny = List[(Any, Any)]

update :: ?CacheLayer[B,H,P,C,DH] -> Tensor[B,H,S,DH] -> Tensor[B,H,S,DH] -> ?Dim -> (Tensor[B,H,key_length,DH], Tensor[B,H,key_length,DH], ?CacheLayer[B,H,key_length,C,DH])
update past k v ?key_length=null = (past == null)
  ? do

position_ids_masked :: TokenIds[B,S] -> Tensor[B,SM] -> Int -> Tensor[B,S]
position_ids_masked x attn_mask pad_fill = do
  pos <- cast attn_mask dtype="long" |> cumsum dim=-1
  pos <- where (eq attn_mask 0) pad_fill (pos - 1)
  return slice pos dim=-1 start=(SM - S) end=SM


position_ids_nomask :: TokenIds[B,S] -> Dim -> Tensor[B,S]
position_ids_nomask x past_length = do
  return arange x start=past_length end=(past_length + S) |>
    cast dtype="long" |>
    reshape shape=[1, S] |>
    expand shape=[B, S]


position_ids :: TokenIds[B,S] -> ?Tensor[B,SM] -> ?Dim -> ?Int -> Tensor[B,S]
position_ids x ?attn_mask=null ?past_length=0 ?pad_fill=0 = (attn_mask == null)
  ? (position_ids_nomask x past_length)
  : (position_ids_masked x attn_mask pad_fill)

position_ids_scale :: Tensor[B,SM] -> Float -> Tensor[B,SM]
position_ids_scale position_ids scale_factor = do
  pos <- cast position_ids dtype="float32"
  return pos / scale_factor


sinusoidal_positions :: Tensor[B,S,D] -> Tensor[B,S] -> ?Float -> ?Int -> ?Int -> ?String -> Tensor[B,S,D]
sinusoidal_positions ref position_ids ?theta=10000.0 ?offset=2 ?padding_idx=null ?mode=null = do
  theta <- (theta == null) ? 10000.0 : theta
  offset <- (offset == null) ? 2 : offset
  mode <- (mode == null) ? "legacy" : mode
  half <- D / 2
  pos <- cast position_ids dtype="float32"
  pos <- pos + offset
  pos <- reshape pos shape=[B, S, 1]
  freq_idx <- arange ref start=0 end=half |> cast dtype="float32"
  inv_freq <- (mode == "rope")
    ? do
      inv_shape <- freq_idx / half
      return exp (0 - ((log theta) * inv_shape))
    : do
      den <- (((half - 1) > 0) ? (half - 1) : 1)
      inv_shape <- freq_idx / den
      return exp (0 - ((log theta) * inv_shape))
  inv_freq <- reshape inv_freq shape=[1, 1, half]
  angles <- pos * inv_freq
  sin_part <- sin angles
  cos_part <- cos angles
  emb <- concat sin_part cos_part dim=-1
  emb <- ((D % 2) == 0)
    ? emb
    : do
      pad <- (slice ref dim=-1 start=0 end=1) * 0.0
      padded <- concat emb pad dim=-1
      ref_shape <- shape ref
      return reshape padded shape=ref_shape
  emb <- (padding_idx == null)
    ? emb
    : do
      mask <- eq position_ids padding_idx |> unsqueeze dim=-1
      return where mask (zeros_like emb) emb
  return cast_like emb ref



-- === ROPE HELPERS ===
rope_rotate_half_noninterleaved :: Tensor[B,H,S,R] -> Tensor[B,H,S,R]
rope_rotate_half_noninterleaved x = do
  x1 <- slice x dim=-1 start=0 end=(R / 2)
  x2 <- slice x dim=-1 start=(R / 2) end=R
  return concat (0 - x2) x1 dim=-1


rope_rotate_half_interleaved :: Tensor[B,H,S,R] -> Tensor[B,H,S,R]
rope_rotate_half_interleaved x = do
  pair <- reshape x shape=[B, H, S, (R / 2), 2]
  even <- slice pair dim=-1 start=0 end=1 |> reshape shape=[B, H, S, (R / 2)]
  odd <- slice pair dim=-1 start=1 end=2 |> reshape shape=[B, H, S, (R / 2)]
  neg_odd <- reshape (0 - odd) shape=[B, H, S, (R / 2), 1]
  even <- reshape even shape=[B, H, S, (R / 2), 1]
  return concat neg_odd even dim=-1 |> reshape shape=[B, H, S, R]


rope_rotate_half :: Tensor[B,H,S,R] -> ?Bool -> Tensor[B,H,S,R]
rope_rotate_half x ?interleaved=false = interleaved
  ? (rope_rotate_half_interleaved x)
  : (rope_rotate_half_noninterleaved x)


rope_split_interleaved_to_half :: Tensor[B,H,S,R] -> Tensor[B,H,S,R]
rope_split_interleaved_to_half x = do
  pair <- reshape x shape=[B, H, S, (R / 2), 2]
  return transpose pair dim1=3 dim2=4 |> reshape shape=[B, H, S, R]


rope_expand_half :: Tensor[B,HM,S,RH] -> Tensor[B,HM,S,2 * RH]
rope_expand_half x = do
  xx <- concat x x dim=-1
  b <- size x dim=0
  hm <- size x dim=1
  s <- size x dim=2
  rh <- size x dim=-1
  r <- 2 * rh
  return reshape xx shape=[b, hm, s, r]


rope_expand_half_interleaved :: Tensor[B,HM,S,RH] -> Tensor[B,HM,S,2 * RH]
rope_expand_half_interleaved x = do
  b <- size x dim=0
  hm <- size x dim=1
  s <- size x dim=2
  rh <- size x dim=-1
  pair <- reshape x shape=[b, hm, s, rh, 1]
  pair <- concat pair pair dim=-1
  r <- 2 * rh
  return reshape pair shape=[b, hm, s, r]


rope_apply_raw :: Tensor[B,H,S,R] -> Tensor[B,S] -> Float -> ?Bool -> Tensor[B,H,S,R]
rope_apply_raw x position_ids theta ?interleaved=false = do
  ref <- slice x dim=1 start=0 end=1 |> reshape shape=[B, S, R]
  emb <- sinusoidal_positions ref position_ids theta=theta offset=0 padding_idx=null mode="rope"
  sin_half <- slice emb dim=-1 start=0 end=(R / 2)
  cos_half <- slice emb dim=-1 start=(R / 2) end=R
  sin_half <- reshape sin_half shape=[B, 1, S, (R / 2)]
  cos_half <- reshape cos_half shape=[B, 1, S, (R / 2)]
  sin <- interleaved ? (rope_expand_half_interleaved sin_half) : (rope_expand_half sin_half)
  cos <- interleaved ? (rope_expand_half_interleaved cos_half) : (rope_expand_half cos_half)
  sin <- expand sin shape=[B, H, S, R]
  cos <- expand cos shape=[B, H, S, R]
  return (x * cos) + ((rope_rotate_half x interleaved=interleaved) * sin)


rope_base_factors :: Tensor[B,S] -> Dim -> ?Float -> ?Bool -> ?Float -> (Tensor[B,1,S,R], Tensor[B,1,S,R])
rope_base_factors position_ids rotary_dim ?theta=10000.0 ?interleaved=false ?scale_factor=null = do
  position_ids <- (scale_factor == null) ? position_ids : (position_ids_scale position_ids scale_factor)
rope_freq_scale_factors_for_position_ids position_ids head_dim theta scale_factor low_freq_factor high_freq_factor original_context ?interleaved=false = do
  ref <- zeros position_ids shape=[B, 1, S, head_dim] dtype="float32"
  sin, cos <- rope_freq_scale_factors ref position_ids theta scale_factor low_freq_factor high_freq_factor original_context interleaved=interleaved
  return sin, cos


rope_apply_factors :: Tensor[B,H,S,R] -> Tensor[B,HM,S,R] -> Tensor[B,HM,S,R] -> ?Bool -> Tensor[B,H,S,R]
rope_apply_factors x sin cos ?interleaved=false = do
  sin <- expand sin shape=[B, H, S, R]
  cos <- expand cos shape=[B, H, S, R]
  return (x * cos) + ((rope_rotate_half x interleaved=interleaved) * sin)

rope_apply_prefix_factors :: Tensor[B,H,S,HD] -> Tensor[B,HM,S,R] -> Tensor[B,HM,S,R] -> Dim -> ?Bool -> Tensor[B,H,S,HD]
rope_apply_prefix_factors x sin cos rot ?interleaved=false = do
  x_rot <- slice x dim=-1 start=0 end=rot
  x_tail <- slice x dim=-1 start=rot end=HD
  x_rot <- rope_apply_factors x_rot sin cos interleaved=interleaved
  return concat x_rot x_tail dim=-1

rope_apply_raw_inverse :: Tensor[B,H,S,R] -> Tensor[B,S] -> Float -> ?Bool -> Tensor[B,H,S,R]

  even <- slice pair dim=-1 start=0 end=1 |> reshape shape=[B, H, S, (R / 2)]
  odd <- slice pair dim=-1 start=1 end=2 |> reshape shape=[B, H, S, (R / 2)]
  neg_odd <- reshape (0 - odd) shape=[B, H, S, (R / 2), 1]
  even <- reshape even shape=[B, H, S, (R / 2), 1]
  return concat neg_odd even dim=-1 |> reshape shape=[B, H, S, R]


rope_rotate_half :: Tensor[B,H,S,R] -> ?Bool -> Tensor[B,H,S,R]
rope_rotate_half x ?interleaved=false = interleaved
  ? (rope_rotate_half_interleaved x)
  : (rope_rotate_half_noninterleaved x)


rope_split_interleaved_to_half :: Tensor[B,H,S,R] -> Tensor[B,H,S,R]
rope_split_interleaved_to_half x = do
  pair <- reshape x shape=[B, H, S, (R / 2), 2]
  return transpose pair dim1=3 dim2=4 |> reshape shape=[B, H, S, R]


rope_expand_half :: Tensor[B,HM,S,RH] -> Tensor[B,HM,S,2 * RH]
rope_expand_half x = do
  xx <- concat x x dim=-1
  b <- size x dim=0
  hm <- size x dim=1
  s <- size x dim=2
  rh <- size x dim=-1
  r <- 2 * rh
  return reshape xx shape=[b, hm, s, r]


rope_expand_half_interleaved :: Tensor[B,HM,S,RH] -> Tensor[B,HM,S,2 * RH]
rope_expand_half_interleaved x = do
  b <- size x dim=0
  hm <- size x dim=1
  s <- size x dim=2
  rh <- size x dim=-1
  pair <- reshape x shape=[b, hm, s, rh, 1]
  pair <- concat pair pair dim=-1
  r <- 2 * rh
  return reshape pair shape=[b, hm, s, r]


rope_apply_raw :: Tensor[B,H,S,R] -> Tensor[B,S] -> Float -> ?Bool -> Tensor[B,H,S,R]
rope_apply_raw x position_ids theta ?interleaved=false = do
  ref <- slice x dim=1 start=0 end=1 |> reshape shape=[B, S, R]
  emb <- sinusoidal_positions ref position_ids theta=theta offset=0 padding_idx=null mode="rope"
  sin_half <- slice emb dim=-1 start=0 end=(R / 2)
  cos_half <- slice emb dim=-1 start=(R / 2) end=R
  sin_half <- reshape sin_half shape=[B, 1, S, (R / 2)]
  cos_half <- reshape cos_half shape=[B, 1, S, (R / 2)]
  sin <- interleaved ? (rope_expand_half_interleaved sin_half) : (rope_expand_half sin_half)
  cos <- interleaved ? (rope_expand_half_interleaved cos_half) : (rope_expand_half cos_half)
  sin <- expand sin shape=[B, H, S, R]
  cos <- expand cos shape=[B, H, S, R]
  return (x * cos) + ((rope_rotate_half x interleaved=interleaved) * sin)


rope_base_factors :: Tensor[B,S] -> Dim -> ?Float -> ?Bool -> ?Float -> (Tensor[B,1,S,R], Tensor[B,1,S,R])
rope_base_factors position_ids rotary_dim ?theta=10000.0 ?interleaved=false ?scale_factor=null = do
  position_ids <- (scale_factor == null) ? position_ids : (position_ids_scale position_ids scale_factor)
rope_freq_scale_factors_for_position_ids position_ids head_dim theta scale_factor low_freq_factor high_freq_factor original_context ?interleaved=false = do
  ref <- zeros position_ids shape=[B, 1, S, head_dim] dtype="float32"
  sin, cos <- rope_freq_scale_factors ref position_ids theta scale_factor low_freq_factor high_freq_factor original_context interleaved=interleaved
  return sin, cos


rope_apply_factors :: Tensor[B,H,S,R] -> Tensor[B,HM,S,R] -> Tensor[B,HM,S,R] -> ?Bool -> Tensor[B,H,S,R]
rope_apply_factors x sin cos ?interleaved=false = do
  sin <- expand sin shape=[B, H, S, R]
  cos <- expand cos shape=[B, H, S, R]
  return (x * cos) + ((rope_rotate_half x interleaved=interleaved) * sin)

rope_apply_prefix_factors :: Tensor[B,H,S,HD] -> Tensor[B,HM,S,R] -> Tensor[B,HM,S,R] -> Dim -> ?Bool -> Tensor[B,H,S,HD]
rope_apply_prefix_factors x sin cos rot ?interleaved=false = do
  x_rot <- slice x dim=-1 start=0 end=rot
  x_tail <- slice x dim=-1 start=rot end=HD
  x_rot <- rope_apply_factors x_rot sin cos interleaved=interleaved
  return concat x_rot x_tail dim=-1

        return self.local_attention // 2

class ModernBertEmbeddings(nn.Module):
    """
    Same as BertEmbeddings with a tiny tweak for positional embeddings indexing.
    """

    def __init__(self, config: ModernBertConfig):
        super().__init__()
        self.config = config
        self.tok_embeddings = nn.Embedding(config.vocab_size, config.hidden_size, padding_idx=config.pad_token_id)
        self.norm = nn.LayerNorm(config.hidden_size, eps=config.norm_eps, bias=config.norm_bias)
        self.drop = nn.Dropout(config.embedding_dropout)

        self, input_ids: torch.LongTensor | None = None, inputs_embeds: torch.Tensor | None = None

class ModernBertMLP(nn.Module):
    """Applies the GLU at the end of each ModernBERT layer.

    Compared to the default BERT architecture, this block replaces :class:`~transformers.model.bert.modeling_bert.BertIntermediate`
    and :class:`~transformers.model.bert.modeling_bert.SelfOutput` with a single module that has similar functionality.
    """

    def __init__(self, config: ModernBertConfig):
        super().__init__()
        self.config = config
        self.Wi = nn.Linear(config.hidden_size, int(config.intermediate_size) * 2, bias=config.mlp_bias)
        self.act = ACT2FN[config.hidden_activation]
        self.drop = nn.Dropout(config.mlp_dropout)
        self.Wo = nn.Linear(config.intermediate_size, config.hidden_size, bias=config.mlp_bias)

    def forward(self, hidden_states: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
        input, gate = self.Wi(hidden_states).chunk(2, dim=-1)
        return self.Wo(self.drop(self.act(input) * gate))

    @deprecate_kwarg("device", version="5.18")
    def __init__(self, config: ModernBertConfig, device=None):

        self.original_max_seq_len = config.max_position_embeddings
        self.config = config
        self.layer_types = sorted(set(config.layer_types))
        self.rope_type = {}
        for layer_type in self.layer_types:
            rope_params = self.config.rope_parameters[layer_type]
            if rope_params is None:
                continue

            self.rope_type[layer_type] = rope_params["rope_type"]
            rope_init_fn: Callable = self.compute_default_rope_parameters
            if self.rope_type[layer_type] != "default":
                rope_init_fn = ROPE_INIT_FUNCTIONS[self.rope_type[layer_type]]
            curr_inv_freq, curr_attention_scaling = rope_init_fn(self.config, device, layer_type=layer_type)
            setattr(self, f"{layer_type}_inv_freq", nn.Buffer(curr_inv_freq, persistent=False))
            setattr(self, f"{layer_type}_original_inv_freq", nn.Buffer(curr_inv_freq.clone(), persistent=False))
            setattr(self, f"{layer_type}_attention_scaling", curr_attention_scaling)

    @staticmethod
    @deprecate_kwarg("device", version="5.18")
    def compute_default_rope_parameters(
        config: ModernBertConfig, device=None, layer_type: str | None = None, **kwargs
    ) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, float]:
        """
        Computes the inverse frequencies according to the original RoPE implementation
        Args:
            config ([`~transformers.PreTrainedConfig`]):
                The model configuration.
            layer_type (`str`):
                The current layer type if the model has different RoPE parameters per type.
                Should not be used unless `config.layer_types is not None`

        Returns:
            Tuple of (`torch.Tensor`, `float`), containing the inverse frequencies for the RoPE embeddings and the
            post-processing scaling factor applied to the computed cos/sin (unused in this type of RoPE).
        """
        # For backward compatibility standardize the `rope_parameters_dict` if it uses old format
        base = config.rope_parameters[layer_type]["rope_theta"]
        dim = getattr(config, "head_dim", None) or config.hidden_size // config.num_attention_heads

        attention_factor = 1.0  # Unused in this type of RoPE
        # Compute the inverse frequencies
        inv_freq = 1.0 / (base ** (torch.arange(0, dim, 2, dtype=torch.float) / dim))
        return inv_freq.to(device), attention_factor

    @torch.no_grad()
    @dynamic_rope_update  # power user: used with advanced RoPE types (e.g. dynamic rope)
    def forward(self, x, position_ids, layer_type):
        inv_freq = getattr(self, f"{layer_type}_inv_freq")
        attention_scaling = getattr(self, f"{layer_type}_attention_scaling")

        inv_freq_expanded = (
            inv_freq[None, :, None].expand(position_ids.shape[0], -1, 1).to(dtype=torch.float, device=x.device)
        )
        position_ids_expanded = position_ids[:, None, :].float()

def eager_attention_forward(
    module: nn.Module,
    query: torch.Tensor,
    key: torch.Tensor,
    value: torch.Tensor,
    attention_mask: torch.Tensor | None,
    scaling: float,
    dropout: float = 0.0,
    **kwargs,
):
    attn_weights = torch.matmul(query, key.transpose(2, 3)) * scaling
    if attention_mask is not None:
        attn_weights = attn_weights + attention_mask

    attn_weights = nn.functional.softmax(attn_weights, dim=-1, dtype=torch.float32).to(query.dtype)
    attn_weights = nn.functional.dropout(attn_weights, p=dropout, training=module.training)

    attn_output = torch.matmul(attn_weights, value)
    attn_output = attn_output.transpose(1, 2).contiguous()
    return attn_output, attn_weights


def rotate_half(x):
    """Rotates half the hidden dims of the input."""
    x1 = x[..., : x.shape[-1] // 2]
    x2 = x[..., x.shape[-1] // 2 :]
    return torch.cat((-x2, x1), dim=-1)


@use_kernel_forward_from_hub("rotary_pos_emb")
def apply_rotary_pos_emb(q, k, cos, sin, unsqueeze_dim=1):
    """Applies Rotary Position Embedding to the query and key tensors.

    Args:
        q (`torch.Tensor`): The query tensor.
        k (`torch.Tensor`): The key tensor.
        cos (`torch.Tensor`): The cosine part of the rotary embedding.
        sin (`torch.Tensor`): The sine part of the rotary embedding.
        unsqueeze_dim (`int`, *optional*, defaults to 1):
            The 'unsqueeze_dim' argument specifies the dimension along which to unsqueeze cos[position_ids] and
            sin[position_ids] so that they can be properly broadcasted to the dimensions of q and k. For example, note
            that cos[position_ids] and sin[position_ids] have the shape [batch_size, seq_len, head_dim]. Then, if q and
            k have the shape [batch_size, heads, seq_len, head_dim], then setting unsqueeze_dim=1 makes
            cos[position_ids] and sin[position_ids] broadcastable to the shapes of q and k. Similarly, if q and k have
            the shape [batch_size, seq_len, heads, head_dim], then set unsqueeze_dim=2.
    Returns:
        `tuple(torch.Tensor)` comprising of the query and key tensors rotated using the Rotary Position Embedding.
    """
    original_dtype = q.dtype
    cos = cos.unsqueeze(unsqueeze_dim)
    sin = sin.unsqueeze(unsqueeze_dim)
    q_embed = (q.float() * cos) + (rotate_half(q.float()) * sin)
    k_embed = (k.float() * cos) + (rotate_half(k.float()) * sin)
    return q_embed.to(original_dtype), k_embed.to(original_dtype)

class ModernBertAttention(nn.Module):
    """Performs multi-headed self attention on a batch of unpadded sequences.

    If Flash Attention 2 is installed, this module uses Flash Attention to improve throughput.
    If Flash Attention 2 is not installed, the implementation will use PyTorch's SDPA kernel,
    which requires padding and unpadding inputs, adding some overhead.

    See `forward` method for additional details.
    """

    def __init__(self, config: ModernBertConfig, layer_idx: int | None = None):
        super().__init__()
        self.config = config
        self.layer_idx = layer_idx

        if config.hidden_size % config.num_attention_heads != 0:
            raise ValueError(
                f"The hidden size ({config.hidden_size}) is not a multiple of the number of attention heads ({config.num_attention_heads})"
            )

        self.attention_dropout = config.attention_dropout
        self.deterministic_flash_attn = config.deterministic_flash_attn
        self.head_dim = config.hidden_size // config.num_attention_heads
        self.Wqkv = nn.Linear(
            config.hidden_size, 3 * self.head_dim * config.num_attention_heads, bias=config.attention_bias
        )

        if config.layer_types[layer_idx] == "sliding_attention":
            # config.sliding_window = local_attention // 2 (half-window size, e.g. 64 for local_attention=128)
            # +1 is needed because flash attention sets inclusive boundaries (see modeling_flash_attention_utils.py)
            self.sliding_window = config.sliding_window + 1
        else:
            self.sliding_window = None

        self.is_causal = False

        self.Wo = nn.Linear(config.hidden_size, config.hidden_size, bias=config.attention_bias)
        self.out_drop = nn.Dropout(config.attention_dropout) if config.attention_dropout > 0.0 else nn.Identity()

    def forward(
        self,
        hidden_states: torch.Tensor,
        position_embeddings: tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor] | None = None,
        attention_mask: torch.Tensor | None = None,
        **kwargs: Unpack[TransformersKwargs],
    ) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor | None]:
        input_shape = hidden_states.shape[:-1]

        qkv = self.Wqkv(hidden_states)
        qkv = qkv.view(*input_shape, 3, -1, self.head_dim)
        query_states, key_states, value_states = qkv.unbind(dim=-3)

        query_states = query_states.transpose(1, 2)
        key_states = key_states.transpose(1, 2)
        value_states = value_states.transpose(1, 2)

        cos, sin = position_embeddings
        query_states, key_states = apply_rotary_pos_emb(query_states, key_states, cos, sin, unsqueeze_dim=1)

        attention_interface: Callable = ALL_ATTENTION_FUNCTIONS.get_interface(
            self.config._attn_implementation, eager_attention_forward
        )

        attn_output, attn_weights = attention_interface(
            self,
            query_states,
            key_states,
            value_states,
            attention_mask,
            dropout=self.attention_dropout if self.training else 0.0,
            scaling=self.head_dim**-0.5,
            sliding_window=self.sliding_window,
            deterministic=self.deterministic_flash_attn,
            **kwargs,
        )

        attn_output = attn_output.reshape(*input_shape, -1).contiguous()
        attn_output = self.out_drop(self.Wo(attn_output))
        return attn_output, attn_weights


class ModernBertEncoderLayer(GradientCheckpointingLayer):
    def __init__(self, config: ModernBertConfig, layer_idx: int | None = None):
        super().__init__()
        self.config = config
        self.layer_idx = layer_idx
        if layer_idx == 0:
            self.attn_norm = nn.Identity()
        else:
            self.attn_norm = nn.LayerNorm(config.hidden_size, eps=config.norm_eps, bias=config.norm_bias)
        self.attn = ModernBertAttention(config=config, layer_idx=layer_idx)
        self.mlp_norm = nn.LayerNorm(config.hidden_size, eps=config.norm_eps, bias=config.norm_bias)
        self.mlp = ModernBertMLP(config)
        self.attention_type = config.layer_types[layer_idx]

    def forward(
        self,
        hidden_states: torch.Tensor,
        attention_mask: torch.Tensor | None = None,
        position_embeddings: torch.Tensor | None = None,
        **kwargs: Unpack[TransformersKwargs],
    ) -> torch.Tensor:
        attn_output, _ = self.attn(
            self.attn_norm(hidden_states),
            position_embeddings=position_embeddings,
            attention_mask=attention_mask,
            **kwargs,
        )
        hidden_states = hidden_states + attn_output
        hidden_states = hidden_states + self.mlp(self.mlp_norm(hidden_states))
        return hidden_states


@auto_docstring
class ModernBertPreTrainedModel(PreTrainedModel):
    config: ModernBertConfig
    base_model_prefix = "model"
    supports_gradient_checkpointing = True
    _no_split_modules = ["ModernBertEmbeddings", "ModernBertEncoderLayer"]
    _supports_flash_attn = True
    _supports_sdpa = True
    _supports_flex_attn = True
    _supports_attention_backend = True

    _can_record_outputs = {
        "hidden_states": ModernBertEncoderLayer,
        "attentions": ModernBertAttention,
    }

    @torch.no_grad()
    def _init_weights(self, module: nn.Module):
        super()._init_weights(module)
        cutoff_factor = self.config.initializer_cutoff_factor
        if cutoff_factor is None:
            cutoff_factor = 3

        def init_weight(module: nn.Module, std: float):
            init.trunc_normal_(
                module.weight,
                mean=0.0,
                std=std,
                a=-cutoff_factor * std,
                b=cutoff_factor * std,
            )

            if isinstance(module, nn.Linear):
                if module.bias is not None:
                    init.zeros_(module.bias)

        stds = {
            "in": self.config.initializer_range,
            "out": self.config.initializer_range / math.sqrt(2.0 * self.config.num_hidden_layers),
            "embedding": self.config.initializer_range,
            "final_out": self.config.hidden_size**-0.5,
        }

        if isinstance(module, ModernBertEmbeddings):
            init_weight(module.tok_embeddings, stds["embedding"])
        elif isinstance(module, ModernBertMLP):
            init_weight(module.Wi, stds["in"])
            init_weight(module.Wo, stds["out"])
        elif isinstance(module, ModernBertAttention):
            init_weight(module.Wqkv, stds["in"])
            init_weight(module.Wo, stds["out"])
        elif isinstance(module, ModernBertPredictionHead):
            init_weight(module.dense, stds["out"])
        elif isinstance(module, ModernBertForMaskedLM):
            init_weight(module.decoder, stds["out"])
        elif isinstance(
            module,
            (
                ModernBertForSequenceClassification,
                ModernBertForMultipleChoice,
                ModernBertForTokenClassification,
                ModernBertForQuestionAnswering,
            ),
        ):
            init_weight(module.classifier, stds["final_out"])
        elif isinstance(module, ModernBertRotaryEmbedding):
            for layer_type in module.layer_types:
                rope_init_fn = module.compute_default_rope_parameters
                if module.rope_type[layer_type] != "default":
                    rope_init_fn = ROPE_INIT_FUNCTIONS[module.rope_type[layer_type]]
                curr_inv_freq, _ = rope_init_fn(module.config, layer_type=layer_type)
                init.copy_(getattr(module, f"{layer_type}_inv_freq"), curr_inv_freq)
                init.copy_(getattr(module, f"{layer_type}_original_inv_freq"), curr_inv_freq)


@auto_docstring
class ModernBertModel(ModernBertPreTrainedModel):
    def __init__(self, config: ModernBertConfig):
        super().__init__(config)
        self.config = config
        self.embeddings = ModernBertEmbeddings(config)
        self.layers = nn.ModuleList(
            [ModernBertEncoderLayer(config, layer_idx) for layer_idx in range(config.num_hidden_layers)]
        )
        self.final_norm = nn.LayerNorm(config.hidden_size, eps=config.norm_eps, bias=config.norm_bias)
